out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped COCKROACHES were found on the premises on sticky traps located by the 3 compartment sink and mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. Establishment has monthly pest service, PIC recommended increasing the frequency of pest control services to eradicate pest issues.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed black duct tape on the prep table across from fryers, PIC stated it is to cover wells they no longer use.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Please replace tape with a smooth and cleanable material.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the HANDSINK @ 3 VAT SINK is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC stated a plumber has already been called and will be out for service.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located over PREP SINK at the VEGETABLE PREP STATION where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Please move pest traps so they are not able to fall into food preparation area.

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped cockroaches were found on the premises by the mop sink and soda storage in back.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. EHS discussed pest traps with PIC.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed BOWLS FOR TOSSING POTATO FRIES AND CHICKEN WINGS located at the COOKLINE that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours. PIC stated bowls are wiped down every so often but not taken to wash, rinse, and sanitize every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. EHS discussed to change tossing bowls at same time as blanched potato fries.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Discard Food when Exceeds 4 Hours
violations.observation: Blanched fries marked with endpoint time observed still at cookline for use after endpoint.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. Upon discussion with PIC, EHS discovered that the facility could not produce a vomit and diarrhea policy in place.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS EMAILED FAIRFAX COUNTY VOMIT AND DIARRHEA POLICY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sinks (nos./capacities)
violations.observation: The handwashing sink next to the 3 compartment sink was not in service during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: At least one hand washing sink, a number of hand washing sinks necessary for their convenient use by employees in areas specified under 5-204.11 and not fewer than the number of hand washing sinks required by Law shall be provided. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC ABOUT THE HANDSINK NEXT TO THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. A WORK ORDER HAS BEEN SUBMITTED TO SERVICE THE HANDSINK. PIC IS WAITING FOR SERVICE.
